title: Chapter 67 Blood Spirit Pill
content:
Chapter 67 Blood Spirit Pill

He came to Dongfang Ling's cell door.

"Thank God, you are finally here!" Dongfang Ling was so excited that she wanted to cry.

Seeing Wang Shuo did not respond.

Dongfang Ling put down her lady's airs, lowered her voice and said: "Hello!"

"Hehe, what do you think about me?" Wang Shuo said unhappily with a bad face.

At this moment, he was covered in blood, his health was very unhealthy, and it was a bit difficult to walk. Are you okay?

God knows what is good about you. Wang Shuo's words made Dongfang Ling unable to do it!

"Is it because my way of greeting is wrong?" Dongfang Ling wondered in her heart.

Isn't this how normal people greet each other?

But at this time, she had something to ask of others. She suppressed her anger, squeezed out a smile on her face, and whispered: "It's good to be alive."

Although there was an iron door between them, Wang Shuo still heard her muttering!

Yes, it's good to be alive!

"I'm here to rescue you out." Wang Shuo said straight to the point.

"Hey, you finally found your conscience!"

When Dongfang Ling heard that the other party was going to let her go, she regained some of her nature and became energetic all of a sudden.

"But, you also saw that our current state is not very good..."

"So, do you have anything that can restore your health?" Wang Shuo asked confidently.

He was going to make a deal with her now.

"So, I'll give you supplies, and you'll let me out?" Dongfang Ling's face changed slightly, and she was a little unhappy.

It turned out that this kid was not impressed by her beauty, nor did he find his conscience, but actually wanted to blackmail her.

However, at this time, people had to bow their heads under the eaves.

"You can understand it this way." Wang Shuo nodded.

Dongfang Ling thought about it, and then scanned everyone one by one, and had an idea in his mind.

"Okay, I promise you, but I have a condition." Dongfang Ling's eyes flashed with light, and a bright smile appeared on his face.

If the housekeeper of Qingyang Mansion saw that their young lady had this expression, he would know that someone was going to be unlucky again.

But Wang Shuo didn't know that he was in urgent need of recovery items at the moment, so he had to say in a deep voice: "What conditions?"

"Just let me follow you." Dongfang Ling smiled.

What kind of weird condition is this?

Wang Shuo thought about it for a long time but couldn't figure it out. This eccentric girl would actually put forward such a condition.

At this moment, Ayub's situation is not optimistic.

He has several horrible wounds on his body, and he is still losing blood so far.

His health is still decreasing. If he doesn't treat it, Wang Shuo may lose his beloved general!

"Okay, I promise you." Although Wang Shuo was a little confused, he still agreed to her request decisively.

"Give me the recovery items first, and I will let you out after we recover." Wang Shuo said a little worriedly.

"You don't look good, but you think beautifully. If you recover and run away directly, what should I do?" Dongfang Ling pointed at Wang Shuo and said angrily.

Both sides were silent!

The atmosphere became strangely quiet.

"How about this, you give one person an item to restore health first, then I'll let you out and give the rest." Wang Shuo pondered for a moment and said slowly.

Dongfang Ling also thought about it and agreed to Wang Shuo's request.

"This is a blood spirit pill, each can restore 2000 health points."

Wang Shuo took the pill and was shocked. This is 10 times more effective than Zhao Bangde's big red pill.

One pill is a life!

Where did this Dongfang Ling come from?

Wang Shuo stared at Dongfang Ling, making her a little scared.

"What do you want to do? I tell you, don't try to hit me. Otherwise, I'll let you die without knowing how."

Wang Shuo also found that he was a little out of control, so he gave the medicine to Ayub directly.

After a few breaths, the wounds on Ayub's body began to scab at a speed visible to the naked eye.

His health was also recovering rapidly. After a series of battles, his level was also upgraded to level 21. Now his total health is 2470 points.

In just a moment, it has recovered to 1800 points.

Wang Shuo also kept his promise and let Baili Liang open the prison door.

"Haha, I'm finally free!" Dongfang Ling exaggeratedly breathed the air outside the prison, although there was nothing different.

Wang Shuo rolled his eyes at her!

"What do you know?" Dongfang Ling took a deep breath and said with her eyes closed, "This is called the breath of freedom!"

From childhood to adulthood, what he hated most was his father's control, so she was very eager for freedom.

"Hey, you should fulfill your promise." Wang Shuo reminded.

"Does this lady look like a debtor?"

After that, she generously gave Wang Shuo 6 blood spirit pills.

Wang Shuo distributed them to everyone one by one, and took one himself.

The effect was surprisingly good.

Wang Shuo said a little embarrassedly: "Do you have any more of this kind of pill?"

"No, I gave it all to you." Dongfang Ling said vigilantly.

Who are you fooling? Only a fool would believe it.

"Don't get me wrong, I want to buy this kind of pill." Wang Shuo explained.

"It's really gone."

"Forget it if it's gone."

Since the other party is unwilling to sell, there is nothing we can do.

Wang Shuo carefully felt the recovery of his body.

After a while, he opened his eyes and looked at his subordinates. They were almost recovered.

So he decided to do the same thing and kill all the bosses in the remaining cells to get the treasures inside.

With experience, it was easy to deal with.

Every time Wang Shuo and Ayub stepped in, they asked someone to open the door quickly, and then closed the door to beat the dog.

In this way, Wang Shuo obtained 5 soul crystals, 420 energy crystals, and a "Qinglong Sword".

[Qinglong Sword: Gold quality long sword, strength +30, agility +10, attack +120, durability 100/100. ]

Seeing this weapon, Wang Shuo liked it very much and gave it to Ayub immediately.

In this way, Ayub's combat power was greatly improved.

Finally, the cells were searched one by one.

Really not an inch of the place was left.

Dongfang Ling saw the behavior of Wang Shuo and others and sneered.

Not long after, they left the Black Dragon City dungeon.

Seeing the outside world, it seemed like a different world.

"I'm hungry." Dongfang Ling looked at Wang Shuo eagerly.

Wang Shuo was a little helpless.

Can you eat strangers' things casually?

Is this little girl a big-headed person, or is she fearless?

He thought about it for a while and it was probably the latter.

Returning to the place where they rested before, Baili Liang exclaimed: "My barbecue."

"Why are you yelling?" Guliji looked at Baili Liang with contempt.

"What's the matter?" Wang Shuo asked.

Baili Liang's face was solemn, and he said seriously: "When we left, I specially roasted a leg of lamb, but now it's gone."

"Isn't it normal for wild animals to come and eat it?" Guliji said casually, "We have been away for so long, maybe it has been roasted to ashes."

"Take a closer look."

Wang Shuo also looked carefully around, and there were no signs of wild animals coming, nor any ashes from roasted meat.

"It seems someone has been here."

At this time, Ayub put his ear to the ground and listened carefully for a while.

He whispered: "A large number of horses are approaching, they may be cavalry!"
